title: I'm Elymas the Heavy Knight
overview: Elymas Edvaughn is disowned by his father for becoming a Heavy Knight.

title: Menacing Foul Eight-Legged Beast
overview: Elymas uses his wits and game knowledge to defeat a much more powerful monster.

title: The Raid Quest
overview: Elymas finds himself surrounded by fearful newbies and an arrogant veteran on his first Raid Quest.

title: Existence Evolution
overview: With Gowtan paralyzed, Elymas must survive against the Mad Headder until he can get back in the fight.

title: Fang of Smoldering Insanity
overview: Elymas goes shopping for a skillbook only to discover they're prohibitively expensive.

title: Ruche the Pierrot
overview: Elymas begs Ruche to join his party so he can use her skills to find the item he needs.

title: Golden Raana Farming
overview: Elymas uses his game knowledge to exploit the weaknesses of the elusive Golden Raana.

title: Wandering
overview: Elymas and Ruche's celebration is interrupted by a wandering dungeon boss.

title: Dreamlord
overview: Ruche returns to save Elymas from a desperate situation, and they make one last gamble to beat the Dreamlord.

title: Negotiation
overview: Elymas and Ruche celebrate their payout and promotion and return to the shady shop for a Skill Book.

title: Inescapable Past
overview: Elymas' father hears about his success and visits the guild with Malice, who has a twisted attachment to him.
